# BottomNavPosition

`Flare.Components.BottomNavPosition`

How FlareBottomNav sits in the page.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Static` | `0` | In the normal flow - the consumer's layout decides where the bar goes. |
| `Sticky` | `1` | Sticks to the bottom of its scroll container once it would scroll out of view. |
| `Fixed` | `2` | Pinned to the bottom of the viewport, above the content and below overlays. This is the PWA case: the bar keeps its safe-area inset and publishes its own height, so the layout can reserve space for it instead of hiding the last row of content behind it. |

## Used by components

- `FlareBottomNav`
